receipts.detail: Red witnesses captured at f04a462e27d51fc0abec67d9d7956bc0a9903c95 (lab/pkg5-red-witness-2) and cf0cad5d0cca67271c1fd5e1f723fbbf9669e9eb (lab/pkg5-divergence-red). Green across separate PgWire gateways/nodes on Receipt 1, Receipt 1b (stale read generation conflict), Witness 1a (leader-side staged-write claims block FOR UPDATE across processes with cleared process-local RESERVATIONS), and Witness 1b (deterministic SQLite-only Raft apply across r1/r2/r3). Fleet runs: lab/pkg5-green-7 (7/7 files, 367 assertions) and lab/pkg5-divergence-green (7/7 files, 370 assertions).

Receipt 2 verifies acquireRowReservation with store === null fails closed without phantom memory entries, and read-only SQLite store causes multi-partition SELECT ... FOR UPDATE to fail closed and roll back partial locks on accounts-p2.

Receipt 3a/3b and Witness 1b verify durable _lagrange_locking_read_reservations survive file-backed SQLite restart and Raft leadership transfer (r1 -> r2 -> r3 deterministic settled outcomes) with zero reliance on process-local RESERVATIONS memory.

Receipt 4 and Witness 2 verify COMMIT, ROLLBACK, abrupt PgWire TCP disconnect, coordinator cancel, coordinator timeout, partial multi-row acquisition rollback, and strictly partition-scoped per-participant release (accounts-p1 release preserves accounts-p2 until accounts-p2 releases itself, plus shared-DB partition isolation).

Receipt 5 verifies scoped INSERT, omitted-PK INSERT, INSERT OR REPLACE, equality UPDATE/DELETE, scan/secondary-index UPDATE/DELETE, and competing SELECT ... FOR UPDATE enforce 55P03 from durable SQLite reservations even with empty process-local maps, while disjoint writes progress.

Independent adversarial review by subagent:e9afe79f-8d12-49c4-86b6-629c54ca6f0c identified replica apply divergence via process-local RESERVATIONS and cross-partition release-scope leakage; both findings were witnessed red at cf0cad5d0cca67271c1fd5e1f723fbbf9669e9eb (lab/pkg5-divergence-red) and verified green at c39c505b40b71734579c93508c241f276ea8b351 (lab/pkg5-divergence-green, 7/7 files, 370 assertions passed).
